busy: All run slots are busy ({limit}). Try again when a run has finished.
too_many_files: At most {limit} files can be attached to a run.
model_not_configured: No model is configured: set DEFAULT_MODEL or pass a model.
gateway_not_configured: The LLM gateway is not configured (LLM_GATEWAY_URL / LLM_API_KEY).
stream_limit: Too many live connections; close another view.
stream_failed: The live connection broke; the run is not restarted automatically.
run_failed: The run failed. No automatic retry was made.
run_timeout: The run reached its time limit.
run_orphaned: The worker disappeared; the run is not restarted automatically.
error_empty_result: The agent returned an empty result.
tool_limit: This run reached its tool-call limit.
web_unavailable: The remote service is unavailable or the response was refused.
search_unavailable: Search is unavailable; no results are claimed.
file_unreadable: The file cannot be read or has changed.
report_limit: The private output store is full.
upload_too_large: The file is too large (limit {limit} bytes).
schedule_missed: A scheduled run was skipped because it was more than 5 minutes late; it is not replayed.
schedule_consent_required: Scheduled runs call the model repeatedly and consume quota: set confirm_recurring_cost to true to enable.
agent_conflict: The agent was changed by someone else; reload it and apply your edit again.
schedule_start_failed: A scheduled run could not be started; it is not retried before the next occurrence.
schedule_required: Enabling a schedule needs a schedule.
agent_limit: At most 100 saved agents are allowed.
schedule_paused: Skipped: the model gateway was rate-limited recently, so scheduled starts are paused for a while. The skipped occurrence is not replayed.
error_rate_limited: The model gateway signalled a limit (rate limit or exhausted budget). This often lasts a while; do not restart immediately. No automatic retry was made.
error_gateway_request: The model gateway rejected the request (check the model name and parameters). No automatic retry was made; start the run again.
prompt_too_long: The prompt is longer than the allowed {limit} characters.
run_blocked_tool_errors: Repeated tool errors or invalid parameters stopped the run; no automatic retry was made.
files_total_too_large: The attached files together may be at most 10 MB.
error_gateway_unavailable: The model gateway was unreachable or timed out. No automatic retry was made; start the run again.
error_gateway_auth: The model gateway rejected the API key; fix the key, then start the run again. No automatic retry was made.
disk_low: Not enough free disk space to start a run safely.
